record.issue_text: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:755 — loadUsers returns eventType.users without the old `|| []` fallback and drops the `organization` select for dynamic users, so users may be undefined or lack organization.slug.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `loadUsers` previously returned `eventType.users || []` when there were no hosts; after the change it returns `users.length ? users : eventType.users` (no `|| []`). That can return `undefined` if `eventType.users` is null/undefined, which would break later code that assumes `users` is an array (e.g., `users.slice(1)`, `users.length`). The claim about dropping `organization.slug` in the dynamic-users select is shown (the `organization: { select: { slug: true } }` block was removed), but whether that causes breakage isn’t verifiable from this diff alone.
